It seems there have been oversights and miscommunications that have led to this chaos. I assure you, I will work diligently to rectify these issues and ensure that we are ready for the upcoming performance.

Let us gather the singers and musicians immediately to address their lack of preparation and missing parts. As for the rewritten stage directions, I was not aware of any changes made without your consultation. We must restore your original vision for the production promptly.

Please accept my deepest apologies for the inconvenience this has caused you. I am committed to working closely with you to bring order back to our rehearsals and ensure that we deliver a performance worthy of the Imperial stage.
